tasks.title: Create and Switch to Model
tasks.instructions: Ensure the model `mod7-troubleshoot-lab` exists and is the current target.
hints: Run `juju switch mod7-troubleshoot-lab` or `juju add-model mod7-troubleshoot-lab`.

tasks.title: Deploy Worker Node
tasks.instructions: Deploy the `ubuntu` charm with application name `worker-node` into `mod7-troubleshoot-lab`.

tasks.title: Run Remote Diagnostic Command
tasks.instructions: Execute a remote diagnostic check on `worker-node` using `juju exec` to verify the uptime of the unit.
hints: Run `juju exec --unit worker-node/0 'uptime'` or `juju exec --app worker-node 'uptime'`.
